subject: [hw] DONE DEC03 rev 6: real first-slice NAL through the vendor ue reader; N2TEST DEC03 PASS 2847/2847
body:
DONE DEC03 rev 6. Supersedes rev 5. Only addition since rev 5: t_vendor now also reads the first real slice NAL (type 5 or 1) of each of the three streams, consumes the NAL header with the vendor's vdec_hal_h264_getrealshtbitstream, and reads first_mb_in_slice with vdec_hal_h264_uecodenum (expected 0 for the first slice) under the A32 interpreter. That is the live slice-header field the VLD is actually used for; the software SPS/PPS path is unchanged and the header-only oracle still does not touch the model.

Last line:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/hw/vdec/run_tests.sh
  -> N2VLD checks 927 pass 927 (x2)
  -> N2VLDV checks 496 pass 496 (x2)
  -> DEC03 arm64 iOS compile: n2vld.c ok
  -> N2TEST DEC03 PASS 2847/2847
  20 s, /tmp/n2hw-DEC03.
Optional oracle: bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/hw/vdec/oracle_ref.sh -> N2TEST DEC03-oracle PASS 12/12.

Unchanged not-done: T02 hook not landed (T02_HOOK.md has the exact text; POLL and WRITE_MASK are the key call sites), window 12 needed for LAT_AVC, LAT vs core [I], no decode completion/IRQ/pixels, VLD pointer units [I], EPB edge cases, no phone, no publish. Files: tests/hw/vdec/{n2vld.h,n2vld.c,t_vld.c,t_vendor.c,run_tests.sh,oracle_ref.sh,REGISTERS.md,T02_HOOK.md} and dsh-state/workers/DEC03/STATUS.md. 128 KB, no file over 300 KB, SPDX MIT. Available for review findings.
